title: Tsetlin Machine Embedding: Representing Words Using Logical Expressions
new_feature: Introduces the TM Autoencoder (Coalesced TM with input masking and freezing of the masked variable) trained self-supervised to produce sparse, interpretable logical word embeddings, where each word is described by clauses over context words.
